description: Static page generator for rental properties landing pages

scripts.build:admin: vite build --config vite.admin.config.ts && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('admin/public/assets', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js', 'admin/public/assets/htmx.min.js');"
scripts.build: tsx render.tsx && vite build && npm run build:admin && npx terser public/js/page-config.js -o dist/js/page-config.js -c -m && npx terser public/js/main.js -o dist/js/main.js -c -m && npx terser public/js/lang-detect.js -o dist/js/lang-detect.js -c -m && npx terser public/js/registry.js -o dist/js/registry.js -c -m && npx terser public/js/guide.js -o dist/js/guide.js -c -m
